data.narrative:
Farm-ng is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Gary Bradski and Ethan Rublee that has raised $16.3M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates against a comp universe of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable, including peers such as Humanoid, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Walden Robotics across Seed through Series B stages.

Two methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a valuation proxy, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $16M base, implying $33M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector comparables—Generalist AI ($2.0B Series B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B Series B), Humanoid ($1.4B Series A), and Walden Robotics ($1.1B Seed)—yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $28M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $841M. The wide spread reflects material stage and growth heterogeneity within the peer set; the stage-progression method anchors to capital deployed, while peer-median reflects substantial valuations in the robotics sector. Key uncertainties include revenue run-rate, path to profitability, and whether peer multiples reflect sustainable market valuations or sector-wide capital concentration.
